mapper.select: SELECT id, move_request_id, move_item_id, purpose, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, created_at FROM request_image WHERE move_request_id = #{moveRequestId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND purpose IN ('APPLIANCE', 'INSTALLATION_ENV') ORDER BY created_at, id

INSERT INTO request_image ( id, move_request_id, move_item_id, storage_provider, object_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, purpose, uploaded_by ) VALUES ( #{imageId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{moveRequestId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{moveItemId, jdbcType=OTHER}, 'LOCAL', #{objectKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{purpose}, #{uploadedBy, jdbcType=OTHER} ) RETURNING id, move_request_id, move_item_id, purpose, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, created_at
